name: EWeb
welcome: Welcome to **EWeb**, a web browser for the Atari Falcon and TT, and, in its ST edition, the ST and STE. It fetches pages itself, secure ones too, and shows them in its own fonts: text, links, headings, lists, tables, pictures and forms, in every screen mode from monochrome to true colour.

window.title: The window
window.intro: One window, as a browser has it:
items: Back and Forward, Reload, Home, Search (the search engine's page) and Stop (while a page loads).
The address: type one, or words to search for, and press Return.
The status bar: a link's address under the mouse, or what a load is doing, with a line that fills as it comes.
The page: click a link to follow it, right-click for more.

diagram.title: How EWeb reaches web sites
diagram.round: [[Falcon mode|Secure sites]]: a Falcon or TT does TLS itself
after: In Falcon mode a Falcon or TT opens secure sites (https) itself, checked against the root certificates next to EWEB.PRG; on a Falcon the DSP does the hardest sums. Or a Raspberry Pi on your network fetches every page for any Atari, secure ones too, and makes the pictures ready for your screen; the ST edition always goes through the Pi. See [[Secure sites]].
